description: Restore a workflow from a local backup. By default creates a new workflow; pass target_workflow_id to overwrite an existing workflow.

backup_path.description: Path returned by n8n_list_backups or mutation output.

server_name.description: Target server name. Uses default if omitted.

target_workflow_id.description: Existing workflow ID to overwrite. If omitted, creates a new workflow.

name: n8n_restore_workflow
